ai.summary: Decision preview is ERROR: the release cannot be evaluated because all Prometheus evidence queries failed (connection refused on 127.0.0.1:1), leaving up, request rate, error ratio, p95 latency, memory, and alert data missing, plus missing raw source series. The change replaces the demo Deployment image digest and two redacted env values in the pod template, and bumps version labels on Deployment, Service, and ServiceMonitor. Because the env values are redacted, it is not possible to confirm that fault-injection settings (e.g. DEMO_ERROR_RATE, DEMO_LATENCY_MS, DEMO_STARTUP_FAIL) are absent; this must be verified before any release. Capacity evidence is also weak: 35 scheduled Pods have no CPU/memory requests and are treated as zero, so free capacity may be overstated. Recommend blocking until metrics collection is restored and the redacted env values are reviewed.

additional_risks.title: Redacted env values may carry fault-injection settings
additional_risks.detail: Two pod-template env values changed but are redacted, so reviewers cannot confirm they are not fault-injection knobs. The trusted cases show that DEMO_ERROR_RATE=1, DEMO_LATENCY_MS=3000, and DEMO_STARTUP_FAIL=true are drill-only settings that must not ship. Require the actual values (or a diff showing them at normal defaults) before release.

additional_risks.title: No observability evidence to gate the rollout
additional_risks.detail: All Prometheus queries failed and up/request-rate/error-ratio/p95/memory/alert evidence is missing, so post-deploy health cannot be validated. Restore metrics collection and re-run evaluation rather than approving on absent data.

additional_risks.title: Capacity may be overstated
additional_risks.detail: 35 scheduled Pods lack CPU/memory requests and are counted as zero, so available capacity (2190m CPU, ~9.2GB memory on one ready worker) may not reflect real headroom for the new image.
